ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling identified by written notice to Garman, operating at Authorized Locations

ops.text: Notwithstanding the non-transferable nature of the licence granted under Section 2 and the restriction in Section 3(c), Sparkling may assign this Agreement, together with the licence granted hereunder, without Garman's consent to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all of its assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have confirmed that affiliates identified by written notice are covered by the licence, and added one sentence letting Sparkling assign this Agreement and the licence to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all of its assets without Garman's consent, disapplying only the non-transferability in Section 2 and the restriction in Section 3(c). Our fallback position requires affiliate coverage on written notice and for the licence to travel with the business; the Authorized Locations limit and the mutual consent default otherwise remain unchanged.
proposal.summary: Cover Sparkling affiliates on written notice and permit Sparkling to transfer the licence to an M&A successor without consent.

mappings.element: Licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
